Lilia begins the ritual at the center point of the area , right next to the hanging tree. She lays out the Raven Queen banner Wynne gave her.. On it, she places her holy symbol, the raven's skull given to her by Web, holy water, and various momentos she has gathered, this includes the momentos given to her by the others. There is a lit incense on each corner of the cloth. She kneels and begins the ritual for Hallow. Her words are in Celestial, || “Raven Queen, I bless this land, in your name. This land, this island, is cursed and I wish to see it healed. Death will not be able to reach you properly if this world is sick. Here I will create a space free from the illnesses of this world and of others. Here a space where death can come naturally, here where the unnatural will not enter.”|| As she prays there is a thin outline of her black wings manifesting behind her. The air around her turns peaceful and cool, and her eyes grow dark.  She continues to pray in Celestial sitting in front of the mini altar she has made.
There is a note that Lilia places in front of the makeshift altar, next to a small clay bowl. It reads: “Place an offering, a memento, something tied to a memory, here."

you can transfer the banner's magic to a place by tracing the krig rune on the ground with your finger. The point where you trace it becomes the center of a spherical area of magic that has a 500-foot radius and that is fixed to the place. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the banner to be within 5 feet of you and during which you choose creatures, creature types, or both that will benefit from the magic. At the end, the banner is destroyed, and the area gains the following property:
While in the 500-foot-radius sphere, the creatures you chose during the transfer process are immune to the frightened condition and gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and AC
